component.name: Loofi Pulse
component.summary: Hardware, temperature, memory pressure, and power monitor for KDE Plasma 6

description.p: Loofi Pulse provides a KDE Plasma 6 panel applet and a Kirigami desktop application for viewing system hardware readings, temperatures, Linux memory and I/O pressure, power, and recent telemetry history. Available readings depend on the sensors and interfaces exposed by the running Linux system.
